goal: A store/orchestrator schema-version mismatch classifies PERMANENT and stops the worker loop after a single distinctly-labelled permanent-stop instead of accumulating identical breaker strikes.

relevant: packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- the cycle loop and the 5-strike breaker (~line 2117); add a permanent-stop exit path distinct from the transient-cycle-failure path
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- the store is reopened every cycle (~line 816), which is why a mismatch raises identically on cycles 1..5
constraints: Classify StoreSchemaError and OrchestratorSchemaError PERMANENT using the classifier from transient-classifier-backoff

schema_mismatch_permanent_stop: a store whose schema_version row is wrong must stop the worker loop after exactly ONE cycle via a distinctly-labelled permanent-stop signal/return, NOT one strike per cycle -- assert the strike/cycle count is 1, not MAX_CONSECUTIVE_CYCLE_FAILURES
The permanent-stop path must be distinguishable from the transient-cycle-failure path (a distinct return/log/signal a grader can assert on)
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done
non_goals: Do not modify files under tests/ except adding the named test; do not weaken existing orchestrator tests
Do not retry a schema mismatch as TRANSIENT (it can never succeed)
Do not let a schema mismatch ride all 5 breaker strikes
edge_cases: A mismatch classified TRANSIENT and retried must fail (it would loop forever)
A mismatch counting 5 strikes before exiting must fail the count-is-1 assertion
